These are Google Reader client tokens — issued to RSS apps (FeedMe, Read You, etc.) when they sign in below, kept separate from your browser sessions above. Revoking one forces that client to sign in again.

RSS Client (Google Reader API)

Connect any RSS reader that supports the Google Reader API (e.g., Reeder, NetNewsWire, FeedMe, Read You, FreshRSS).

Server URLhttp://localhost:18931
Usernamealice
PasswordYour RDRS password

In your RSS client, choose "Google Reader" or "FreshRSS" as the account type and enter the server URL above with your credentials. Some clients may require the FreshRSS-compatible URL: http://localhost:18931/api/greader.php

Change Password

At least 15 characters. A phrase of a few unrelated words works well — no mixture of cases or symbols is required.

Passkeys

Passkeys let you sign in without a password using your device's biometrics or security key.

Applies to categories and to the open category's feeds.
The category or feed you are currently reading stays listed.
(0 = off, max 200) Stores these articles in this browser so you can read them without a connection. Newest unread first, then starred. See what is saved.
Adds an invisible 1×1 image to each entry's content, so opening one is recorded even when it happens in another reader app. Only this server sees the request — nothing leaves this instance. Shows up as an open rate on Feeds and Statistics, which is a better guide to a low-value feed than the read count. Counts only entries that arrive after you switch this on, so the rate starts out empty and fills in as your feeds update — articles already in your library carry no image and are left out of the total.
